sentences.text: In the parcels of land described in the Schedule therein, a plot of land belonging to the petitioner was included.
Subsequent thereto, the process of land acquisition proceeded further.

The Competent Authority, Land Acquisition [CALA] had processed and assessed the compensation amount at Rs. 36,77,866/- as an Award under Section 3G[1] of the N.H. Act, 1956 against the acquisition of the plot of land belonging to the petitioner.
ON 19.02.2024, the CALA asked the respondent NHIDCL authorities to deposit the amount of Rs. 36,77,866/-, which has been passed as an Award under Section 3G[1] of the N.H. Act, 1956.
3. As the awarded amount of Rs. 36,77,866/- has not yet been disbursed to the petitioner, the petitioner is before this Court by the present writ petition.
4. Mr. Baruah, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL has submitted, on instruction, that the awarded amount passed under Section 3G[1] of the N.H. Act, 1956 has already been deposited with the CALA.

5. In view of such submission, Mr. Talukdar, learned Senior Counsel shall take instruction from the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Cachar, Silchar & CALA as regards the deposit of the awarded amount and its disbursement to the petitioner as the beneficiary.

6. As the Additional District Commissioner, Cachar, Silchar & CALA has not been made a party-respondent in this writ petition, Mr. Dey, learned counsel for the petitioner has prayed for and is allowed to file an amended Cause-Title by tomorrow before the Registry.
If such amended Cause-Title is filed, the Registry to do the needful.

7. List the case on 15.12.2025 to enable Mr. Talukdar to obtain the necessary instructions.
